held_out_compositions.data_plus_measurement_heldout: depolarizing data p=.01 plus measurement p=.01

config.validation_shots_split: first half selects correction threshold; independent second half selects lookup vs matching

config.validation_strategy_gate: lookup selected only when held-out policy half has fewer paired residuals and exact McNemar p<0.0125 (Bonferroni over four trained regimes)
